en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet premieres Dunhuang: In Search of Light this weekend
en.dek: The world premiere runs 16-18 October at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, fusing classical ballet with Dunhuang imagery and Hermann Hesse's Siddhartha.
body: Hong Kong Ballet will give the world premiere of Dunhuang: In Search of Light on Friday evening at the Grand Theatre of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The production, created by choreographers Hu Song Wei Ricky and Mai Jingwen, draws on the Mogao Caves of Dunhuang and Hermann Hesse's novel Siddhartha. It follows a young man's search for enlightenment, guided by Feitian, and incorporates immersive visuals and living frescoes. The company said this is its first collaboration with the Dunhuang Academy.

Performances continue on Saturday and Sunday, with matinees on those days. Tickets range from HK$280 to HK$1,380 and are available through URBTIX. The show lasts about one hour and 50 minutes including an intermission and is recommended for ages six and above. Live music is provided by the Hong Kong Sinfonietta.
The work was commissioned by the GBA International Theatre Festival. Hong Kong Ballet described it as an epic that fuses classical technique with cutting-edge visuals celebrating personal awakening.

zh.headline: 港芭《敦煌：溯光行》本周末世界首演
zh.dek: 作品16至18日於香港文化中心上演，結合古典芭蕾、敦煌意象及赫塞《流浪者之歌》。
body: 香港芭蕾舞團周五晚上於尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院世界首演原創作品《敦煌：溯光行》。
編舞胡頌威及麥靜雯以敦煌莫高窟壁畫及赫塞小說《流浪者之歌》為靈感，講述一名年輕人在飛天指引下追尋心靈啟悟的故事，並融入沉浸式影像及活壁畫。港芭表示，這是與敦煌研究院的首次合作。
周六及周日繼續演出，並設日場。票價由280元至1380元，可於城市售票網購買。演出長約1小時50分鐘，包括中場休息，建議6歲或以上觀眾欣賞。現場音樂由香港小交響樂團演奏。
作品由大灣區國際戲劇節委約。港芭形容這是一部將古典芭蕾與前沿視覺元素融合、歌頌個人覺醒的史詩級製作。
